-- Roblox Mobile Exploit GUI: SafeZone Script
-- Поддерживает мобильные экзекуторы (Fluxus, Delta, Hydrogen и др.)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Settings = {
    Enabled = false,
    HpThreshold = 99,
    OffsetDistance = 5,
    OffsetDirection = "Вперед"
}

local State = {
    InSafeZone = false,
    SavedCFrame = nil,
    SafePlatform = nil,
    IsMinimized = false,
    IsPinned = false
}

local SAFE_ZONE_HEIGHT = 5000 

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- СОЗДАНИЕ ПЛАТФОРМЫ
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function CreateSafePlatform(position)
    local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
    folder.Name = "SafeZone_Platform_Container"

    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(40, 2, 40)
    floor.Position = position
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 40)
    floor.Parent = folder

    local wallData = {
        {pos = Vector3.new(0, 10, 20), size = Vector3.new(40, 20, 1)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(0, 10, -20), size = Vector3.new(40, 20, 1)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(20, 10, 0), size = Vector3.new(1, 20, 40)},
        {pos = Vector3.new(-20, 10, 0), size = Vector3.new(1, 20, 40)}
    }

    for _, data in ipairs(wallData) do
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = data.size
        wall.Position = position + data.pos
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.Glass
        wall.Transparency = 0.5
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(130, 180, 255)
        wall.Parent = folder
    end

    folder.Parent = workspace
    return folder, position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
end

local ToggleBtn

local function UpdateToggleVisual()
    if ToggleBtn then
        if Settings.Enabled then
            ToggleBtn.Text = "1 нажатие: включить, 2: выключить (ВКЛ) / 1 click: ON, 2: OFF"
            ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 185, 80)
        else
            ToggleBtn.Text = "1 нажатие: включить, 2: выключить (ВЫКЛ) / 1 click: ON, 2: OFF"
            ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 45, 45)
        end
    end
end

local function TeleportToSafeZone()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    
    if not State.InSafeZone then
        State.SavedCFrame = char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame
        
        local safePos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, SAFE_ZONE_HEIGHT, 0)
        local platFolder, spawnCFrame = CreateSafePlatform(safePos)
        State.SafePlatform = platFolder
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnCFrame)
        State.InSafeZone = true
        
        Settings.Enabled = false
        UpdateToggleVisual()
    end
end

local function ReturnFromSafeZone()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

    if State.InSafeZone and State.SavedCFrame then
        local targetCFrame = State.SavedCFrame
        local dist = Settings.OffsetDistance
        
        if Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вперед" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Назад" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, dist)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Вправо" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(dist, 0, 0)
        elseif Settings.OffsetDirection == "Влево" then
            targetCFrame = targetCFrame * CFrame.new(-dist, 0, 0)
        end
        
        char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetCFrame
        
        if State.SafePlatform then
            State.SafePlatform:Destroy()
            State.SafePlatform = nil
        end
        State.InSafeZone = false
    end
end

local isZoomed = false

local function clearHiddenParts()
    for part, originalTransparency in pairs(hiddenParts) do
        if part and part.Parent then
            part.Transparency = originalTransparency
        end
    end
    hiddenParts = {}
end

local function updateZoom()
    if isZoomed then
        local num = tonumber(zoomBox.Text)
        if num then
            if num < 1 then num = 1 end
            local targetFov = 70 / num
            camera.FieldOfView = math.clamp(targetFov, 0.0001, 70)
        else
            camera.FieldOfView = 70
        end
    else
        camera.FieldOfView = 70
        clearHiddenParts()
    end

        toggleZoomBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 50, 50)
    end
    updateZoom()
end)

zoomBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
    if isZoomed then
        updateZoom()
    end
end)

-- Автоматическое скрытие блоков (игнорируя всех игроков) во время прицеливания
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    clearHiddenParts()
    if not isZoomed then return end

    local hideCount = tonumber(hideBlocksBox.Text)
    if not hideCount or hideCount <= 0 then return end

    local origin = camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = camera.CFrame.LookVector * 100000

    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    
    local ignoreList = {screenGui}
    if player.Character then
        table.insert(ignoreList, player.Character)
    end

    local hiddenCountFound = 0
    local maxIterations = 20
    local iter = 0

    while hiddenCountFound < hideCount and iter < maxIterations do
        iter = iter + 1
        raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignoreList
        local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
        if not result or not result.Instance then break end

        local hitPart = result.Instance

        -- Проверяем, принадлежит ли найденная деталь какому-либо игроку
        local isPlayer = false
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p.Character and hitPart:IsDescendantOf(p.Character) then
                isPlayer = true
                break
            end
        end

        if isPlayer then
            -- Если это игрок, просто пропускаем его и продолжаем луч дальше
            table.insert(ignoreList, hitPart)
            origin = result.Position + (camera.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1)
        else
            if hitPart:IsA("BasePart") then
                if not hiddenParts[hitPart] then
                    hiddenParts[hitPart] = hitPart.Transparency
                end
                hitPart.Transparency = 1
                table.insert(ignoreList, hitPart)
                origin = result.Position + (camera.CFrame.LookVector * 0.1)
                hiddenCountFound = hiddenCountFound + 1
            else
                break
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function slider(page, label, order, min, max, initial, onChanged)
    local r = card(page, order, 48)

    local val = initial
    local nameLabel = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 8),

        Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,

        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        Text = label,
    }, r)

    local valLabel = new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 16),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -74, 0, 8),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = C.accent,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        Text = tostring(val),
    }, r)

    local bar = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 5),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 30),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.track,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, r)
    corner(bar, 3)

    local fill = new("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.fromScale((val - min) / math.max(max - min, 1), 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, bar)
    corner(fill, 3)

    local hit = new("TextButton", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 3, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -7),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, bar)

    local dragging = false
    local function set(x)
        local rel = math.clamp((x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(bar.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
        val = math.floor(min + rel * (max - min) + 0.5)
        fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(rel, 1)
        valLabel.Text = tostring(val)
        pcall(onChanged, val)
    end

    hit.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function()
        dragging = true
        set(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation().X)
    end)
    UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
        if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then dragging = false end
    end)
    UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
        if dragging and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then set(i.Position.X) end
    end)

    return function() return val end
end

-- The Loot All button runs its own 1 s charge before it accepts a press, so a
-- loot has to land after the fill is full, not the instant the chest opens.

local function chestGui()
    local pg = LP:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local cg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("ChestGui")
    if not cg then return nil end
    local frame = cg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    if not frame or not frame.Visible then return nil end
    return cg
end

local function chestButton(cg, name)
    local frame = cg and cg:FindFirstChild("Frame")
    local bottom = frame and frame:FindFirstChild("BottomBar")
    local choices = bottom and bottom:FindFirstChild("Choices")
    local btn = choices and choices:FindFirstChild(name)
    return btn and btn:FindFirstChild("Click") or nil
end

local function pressLootAll(cg)
    local click = chestButton(cg, "LootAllBtn")
    if not click then return false end
    local fired = false
    for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(click.Activated)) do
        local ok = pcall(function() c.Function() end)
        if ok then fired = true end
    end
    return fired
end

toggle(espPage, "Demons", "name + hp + bar over workspace.Alive", 3, false, function(on)
    ENV.espDemons = on
    if not on then clearESP() end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- TAB: STATS
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local statsPage = makeTab("STATS", "STATS", 5)

local statLabels = {}
local statKeys = { "Yen", "Level", "Exp", "ExpToNextLevel", "Faction", "Clan", "Art" }
for i, key in ipairs(statKeys) do
    statLabels[key] = labelRow(statsPage, i, key .. "  -", C.text)
end

section(statsPage, "character", #statKeys + 1)
local charLabel = labelRow(statsPage, #statKeys + 2, "hp  -", C.text)
local wsLabel = labelRow(statsPage, #statKeys + 3, "walkspeed  -", C.text)
local tagLabel = labelRow(statsPage, #statKeys + 4, "tags  -", C.dim)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- ESP helper
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function hpColour(pct)
    local r = 214 + (84 - 214) * pct
    local g = 72 + (200 - 72) * pct
    local b = 72 + (130 - 72) * pct
    return Color3.fromRGB(math.floor(r), math.floor(g), math.floor(b))
end

local function addESP(model, name, colour)
    if not model or not model.Parent then return end
    local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head then return end

    -- a stale billboard from an older panel build has no HP child - rebuild it
    local existing = head:FindFirstChild("OW_ESP")
    if existing then
        if existing:FindFirstChild("HP") then return end
        pcall(function() existing:Destroy() end)
    end

    local billboard = new("BillboardGui", {
        Name = "OW_ESP",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(170, 36),
        StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3.0, 0),
        AlwaysOnTop = true,
        MaxDistance = 900,
    }, head)

    new("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 15),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = colour,
        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
        Text = name,
    }, billboard)

    local hpLabel = new("TextLabel", {
        Name = "HP",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 12),
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 15),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Font = Enum.Font.Code,
        TextSize = 10,
        TextColor3 = C.text,
        TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3,
        Text = "- / -",
    }, billboard)

    local bar = new("Frame", {
        Name = "Bar",
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 4),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -60, 0, 30),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 27),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, billboard)
    corner(bar, 2)

    local fill = new("Frame", {
        Name = "Fill",
        Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = C.good,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, bar)
    corner(fill, 2)

    table.insert(ENV.espObjects, billboard)
    ENV.espMap[billboard] = model
    return billboard, hpLabel, fill
end

local function refreshESP()
    for billboard, model in pairs(ENV.espMap) do
        if not model or not model.Parent then
            pcall(function() billboard:Destroy() end)
            ENV.espMap[billboard] = nil
        else
            local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local hpLabel = billboard:FindFirstChild("HP")
            local bar = billboard:FindFirstChild("Bar")
            local fill = bar and bar:FindFirstChild("Fill")
            if hum and hpLabel then
                local max = math.max(hum.MaxHealth, 1)
                local pct = math.clamp(hum.Health / max, 0, 1)
                hpLabel.Text = string.format("%d / %d", math.floor(hum.Health + 0.5), math.floor(hum.MaxHealth + 0.5))
                hpLabel.TextColor3 = hpColour(pct)
                if fill then
                    fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(pct, 1)
                    fill.BackgroundColor3 = hpColour(pct)
                end
            elseif hpLabel then
                hpLabel.Text = "- / -"
                hpLabel.TextColor3 = C.faint
                if fill then fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1) end
            end
        end
    end
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- loop
------------------------------------------------------------------------
local function nearestDemon(myPos, myChar)
    local alive = workspace:FindFirstChild("Alive")
    if not alive then return nil end
    local best, bd = nil, 1e9
    for _, m in ipairs(alive:GetChildren()) do
        if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= myChar then
            local ok, h = pcall(function() return m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") end)
            local ok2, r = pcall(function() return m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") end)
            if ok and ok2 and h and r and r.Parent and h.Health > 0 then
                local ok3, d = pcall(function() return (r.Position - myPos).Magnitude end)
                if ok3 and d < bd then bd = d best = m end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function input()
    return NET and NET:FindFirstChild("Input") or nil
end

-- One swing path for every source. The interval is a gate, not a feature of
-- auto swing: manual taps and the auto loop both go through here, so the
-- slider keeps working with auto swing off.
local function requestSwing()
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - ENV.lastSwing < ENV.swingInterval then return false end
    local inp = input()
    if not inp then return false end
    ENV.lastSwing = now
    ENV.parryUntil = now + ENV.swingInterval + 0.05
    pcall(function()
        inp:FireServer("LeftClick", { Uppercut = false, Air = false, Space = false })
    end)
    ENV.swings = ENV.swings + 1
    return true
end

ENV.requestSwing = requestSwing

local function loop()
    if not ENV.alive then return end
    local ch = character()
    local hum = humanoid()
    local myRoot = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local now = os.clock()

    if ENV.reachLock and myRoot then
        local target = nearestDemon(myRoot.Position, ch)
        ENV.lockTarget = target
        if target then
            local tr = target:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if tr then
                -- stand on the side the target is not looking at, at the same
                -- distance, and face them so the swing still connects
                local back = tr.CFrame.LookVector
                local pos = tr.Position - back * ENV.lockOffset.Z
                    + Vector3.new(0, ENV.lockOffset.Y, 0)
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, tr.Position)
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.autoSwing and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        requestSwing()
    end

    if ENV.purgeDebuffs then
        local st = state()
        if st then
            for _, name in ipairs(DEBUFFS) do
                if st:Has(name) then pcall(function() st:Remove(name) end) end
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.purgeCooldowns then
        local st = state()
        if st then pcall(function() st:ClearCooldown() end) end
    end

    if ENV.slowImmune and ch and ch:GetAttribute("SlowImmune") ~= true then
        ch:SetAttribute("SlowImmune", true)
    end

    if ENV.noclip and ch then
        for _, part in ipairs(ch:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end

    if ENV.sustain and hum and hum.Health > 0 and hum.Health < hum.MaxHealth then
        hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
    end

    if ENV.lootAll then
        local cg = chestGui()
        if not cg then
            ENV.lootSeen = nil
            ENV.lootCount = 0
        else
            if ENV.lootSeen ~= cg then
                ENV.lootSeen = cg
                ENV.lootAt = now
                ENV.lootCount = 0
            end
            -- the button refuses a press until its charge finished, so hold off
            -- for LOOT_CHARGE and then re-press while the chest is still open
            if ENV.lootCount < 8
                and now - (ENV.lootAt or 0) > LOOT_CHARGE
                and now - (ENV.lastLoot or 0) > 1.4 then
                ENV.lastLoot = now
                if pressLootAll(cg) then ENV.lootCount = ENV.lootCount + 1 end
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.holdBlock and now - ENV.lastBlock > 0.8 then
        ENV.lastBlock = now
        local inp = input()
        if inp then pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", true) end) end
    end

    if ENV.autoParry and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
        local inp = input()
        if inp then
            if now < ENV.parryUntil then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", true) end)
            elseif ENV.parryUntil > 0 then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Block", false) end)
                ENV.parryUntil = 0
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.autoBreathe and hum and hum.Health > 0 and now - ENV.lastBreathe > 1 then
        local inp = input()
        local st = state()
        if inp and ch then
            local b = ch:GetAttribute("Breath")
            local maxb = ch:GetAttribute("MaxBreath") or 100
            local allowed = b ~= nil and b < maxb and not (st and st:Has("Breathing"))
            if allowed then
                pcall(function() inp:FireServer("Breathe", true) end)
                ENV.lastBreathe = now
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.espPlayers or ENV.espDemons then
        -- 10 Hz is plenty for a health readout and keeps the frame cheap
        if now - (ENV.lastESP or 0) > 0.1 then
            ENV.lastESP = now
            refreshESP()
        end
    end

    if ENV.espPlayers then
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LP and p.Character then
                addESP(p.Character, p.Name, C.accent)
            end
        end
    end

    if ENV.espDemons then
        local alive = workspace:FindFirstChild("Alive")
        if alive then
            for _, m in ipairs(alive:GetChildren()) do
                if m:IsA("Model") and not m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Player") then
                    addESP(m, m.Name, Color3.fromRGB(232, 176, 72))
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

ENV.conns[#ENV.conns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    pcall(loop)
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- readouts
------------------------------------------------------------------------
task.spawn(function()
    while ENV.alive do
        task.wait(0.35)
        pcall(function()
            for key, label in pairs(statLabels) do
                local v = LP:GetAttribute(key)
                label.Text = key .. "  " .. (v ~= nil and tostring(v) or "-")
            end

            local hum = humanoid()
            local ch = character()
            charLabel.Text = hum and ("hp  " .. math.floor(hum.Health) .. " / " .. math.floor(hum.MaxHealth)) or "hp  -"
            wsLabel.Text = hum and ("walkspeed  " .. math.floor(hum.WalkSpeed) .. "   tag +" .. ENV.speedValue) or "walkspeed  -"

            if ch and STATE_OK then
                local st = state()
                if st then
                    local n, names = 0, {}
                    for _, t in pairs(st.Tags) do
                        n = n + 1
                        if n <= 5 then names[#names + 1] = t.Name end
                    end
                    tagLabel.Text = "tags  " .. n .. "   " .. (#names > 0 and table.concat(names, ", ") or "none")
                end
            end

            statusLabel.Text = ENV.alive and "live" or "off"
            liveDot.BackgroundColor3 = ENV.alive and C.good or C.faint

            local cg = chestGui()
            chestStatus.Text = cg
                and ("chest  open    looted " .. ENV.lootCount)
                or "chest  closed"
            chestStatus.TextColor3 = cg and C.good or C.faint

            local t = ENV.lockTarget
            if t and t.Parent then
                local tr = t:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local th = t:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local myRoot = root()
                local d = (tr and myRoot) and math.floor((tr.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude) or -1
                footTarget.Text = "target  " .. t.Name:sub(1, 16) .. "   d=" .. d .. "   hp=" .. (th and math.floor(th.Health) or -1)
                footTarget.TextColor3 = C.good
            else
                footTarget.Text = "target  -"
                footTarget.TextColor3 = C.dim
            end
            footSwing.Text = "swings  " .. tostring(ENV.swings)
        end)
    end
end)

------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- boot
------------------------------------------------------------------------
for n, b in pairs(tabButtons) do
    local on = (n == "MOVEMENT")
    pages[n].Visible = on
    b.TextColor3 = on and C.text or C.dim
    b.BackgroundColor3 = on and C.raised or C.surface
    tabAccents[n].Size = UDim2.new(0, 3, 0, on and 18 or 0)
end

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    ENV.alive = false
    for _, c in ipairs(ENV.conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
    gui:Destroy()
    getgenv().OW_PANEL = nil
end)

-- true when the cursor sits over the panel, so a click on a toggle is never
-- also a swing
local function overPanel()
    if not (gui and gui.Enabled and main) then return false end
    local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
    local p, s = main.AbsolutePosition, main.AbsoluteSize
    return m.X >= p.X and m.X <= p.X + s.X and m.Y >= p.Y and m.Y <= p.Y + s.Y
end

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if i.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        if gui then gui.Enabled = not gui.Enabled end
        return
    end

    -- manual swings go through the same gate as auto swing, so the interval
    -- slider still applies when auto swing is off
    if i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
        and ENV.manualGate and ENV.reachLock and not overPanel() then
        requestSwing()
    end
end)

print("[OVERWORLD] panel loaded | StateManager=" .. tostring(STATE_OK) .. " | Network=" .. tostring(NET ~= nil))
